Lessons.Title: Beyond Circles
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Create a trigonometric function to model data, and use the model to make predictions.
To model oscillating data, estimate midline (max+min)/2, amplitude (max-min)/2, period and phase. A sine or cosine prediction applies only if the observed periodic pattern supports it.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Applying an algebraic solution at an excluded input.

CommonMistakes.Correction: State and check the domain before finalising.
